question: Autobiography of an Unknown Indian is the collective memoir of ____________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Nirad C Chaudhari__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Autobiography of an Unknown Indian is the collective memoir of **Nirad C.** **Chaudhuri**, a man remembered for his support of the British Empire at a time that India was struggling to hold on to its newfound freedom.
 
• Nirad Chandra Chaudhuri CBE was an Indian writer. 
 
• Autobiography of an Unknown Indian first published in** 1951**.
 
• **The first book is entitled “Early Environment” and its four chapters are:**__ 
 __
 
• My Place of Birth
 
• My Ancestral Place
 
• The Place of My Mother.
 
• England. The autobiography has acquired many distinguished admirers over the years.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Vikram Seth** is an **Indian novelist and poet**. He has written several novels and poetry books. He has received several awards such as Padma Shri, Sahitya Academy Award, Pravasi Bharatiya Samman, WH Smith Literary Award and Crossword Book Award.
 
• **Ahmed Salman Rushdie** was **born during the British Raj, into an Indian Kashmiri Muslim family**. He is the son of Anis Ahmed Rushdie, a Cambridge-educated lawyer-turned-businessman, and Negin Bhatt, a teacher.
 
• **Amitav Ghosh **was awarded a doctorate from Oxford University. He has written for many publications including The Hindu, The New Yorker and Granta, and taught in universities in both India and the US
